articles.title: Letter: the Kettle Hill Block Association Did a Good Job This Summer
body: To the editor: I have lived on Yardley Lane for 22 years, and I want to say what a difference the Kettle Hill Block Association has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.
Please keep the senior exercise class in the budget. Many of us on Yardley Lane use it every week.
